messages:
Marta: Final call — I'm planning to merge the vendor submodule update + lockfile bump into release-rc branch in ~4h (cutoff 20:30 PT). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8421
Sam: running full test matrix locally now, will report failures.
Kevin: FYI linux-gcc-11 job is failing on link step after openssl bump, same as yesterday.
Lia: I can take a look at the linker flags, maybe need -Wl,--as-needed fix. Assigning to me.
Jordan: If we update the submodule hash we also need to regenerate vendor.tar and run `make vendor-lock` — see the vendor/README.
Marta: yes, exact steps I used in the PR description:
```
git submodule update --init --recursive deps/vendor
cd deps/vendor && ./update.sh <new-hash>
make vendor-lock
git add vendor/ vendor.lock && git commit -m "vendor: bump deps for ml-infra"
```
Sam: after my run: unit tests + integration passed locally except the linux job failed in CI.
ci-bot: CI update — linux-gcc-11 failed (linker), linux-clang-14 passed, macos passed, windows passed.
Lia: opened a tiny fix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8423 — adjusts linker flags and a compat shim.
Kevin: I'll re-run the failed workflow once Lia's PR merges.
Marta: changelog reminder — please add short bullet under "Dependency updates" in changelog/rc.md. Not a full entry, just one liner and reference PR.
Jordan: noted, adding entry now.
Sam: re-run queued. If CI green I can merge before cutoff.
release-bot: Reminder: RC branch cutoff in 3h 45m. Auto-merge window 1h before cutoff for release-captain approvals.
Marta: tagging @release-captain for final sign-off.
release-captain: sign-off from me once CI is green and changelog is in. :thumbsup:
Sam: CI all green. Ready to merge from my side.
Marta: merging now. Thanks everyone :tada:
ci-bot: Merge completed. New rc branch state: commit abc123 -> vendor hash def456, vendor.lock updated.
Marta: follow-up: please watch for post-merge smoke tests and let eng-oncall know if anything crops up.
